name: [[625,4,32]] weight-8 mirror-folded single-layer planar non-CSS stabilizer code

provenance.construction: Euclidean mirror fold (symplectic halving) of an L=25 open-boundary planar CSS code on the 45-degree rotated single-layer square lattice A(i,j)=(i+j,j-i), B(i,j)=(i+j,j-i+1) with supports S_f=[(0,1),(0,3),(1,2),(2,3)] and S_g=[(0,3),(1,1),(2,1),(2,2)], folded across the horizontal reflection line y=0.5 (sigma: A(i,j)<->B(j,i)) onto the y<=0 half-chip.
provenance.notes: Single-layer 2D planar non-CSS stabilizer code from the L^2-qubit Euclidean mirror-folded family [[L^2, 4, ceil(3L/2)-6]] (w=8, layers=1, interaction_radius=4.0). Distance claim d<=32 uses an explicit weight-32 vertical-strip logical witness matching the exact scaling law verified at L=8..15 (stricter than the unrefuted global RIS upper bound of 44).
